title: Bear cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b97a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5228'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='muzzleGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5d9b8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0b78d'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='26' r='12' fill='#8a5228'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='26' r='12' fill='#8a5228'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='26' r='6.5' fill='#e0b78d'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='26' r='6.5' fill='#e0b78d'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='31' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='18' ry='14' fill='url(#muzzleGrad)'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#4a2a18'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='49.5' rx='1.8' ry='1.1' fill='#8a6a52' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 55 Q46 61 43 58' fill='none' stroke='#4a2a18' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q54 61 57 58' fill='none' stroke='#4a2a18' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes: big sparkly -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='7' ry='7.5' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='7' ry='7.5' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='37' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='37' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='42.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65.5' cy='42.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='4.5' fill='#f08a7a' opacity='0.65'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='55' r='4.5' fill='#f08a7a' opacity='0.65'/>

  <!-- sparkles around head -->
  <path d='M14 44 l1.5 3.5 l3.5 1.5 l-3.5 1.5 l-1.5 3.5 l-1.5 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.5 l3.5 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M86 30 l1.2 2.8 l2.8 1.2 l-2.8 1.2 l-1.2 2.8 l-1.2 -2.8 l-2.8 -1.2 l2.8 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M84 62 l1 2.4 l2.4 1 l-2.4 1 l-1 2.4 l-1 -2.4 l-2.4 -1 l2.4 -1 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M16 68 l1 2.4 l2.4 1 l-2.4 1 l-1 2.4 l-1 -2.4 l-2.4 -1 l2.4 -1 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='22' ry='16' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e0b78d'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='78' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#8a5228' transform='rotate(20 28 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='78' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#8a5228' transform='rotate(-20 72 78)'/>

  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='88' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#b97a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='88' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#b97a4a'/>
</svg>
